name: Cross-Company Acceptance
required_scope: Rerun CROX, AZO, and the preserved unfamiliar company.
Confirm safe handling of MISSING, NOT_APPLICABLE, WARNING, and HARD_STOP.
Confirm that no ticker-specific patch or hard-coded analytical value was introduced.
contract_changes: No S07 analytical contract or shared rule changed during the S08 first run.
S08 adds an acceptance harness and immutable first-run evidence, not a new company-analysis rule.
The harness verifies that formal reports are blocked at Gate 0 and only a diagnostic artifact is rendered when a live Hard Stop is present.

safe_outcome_acceptance.behavior: Missing disclosure remains explicit, carries remediation, and is never converted to zero.
The status requires explicit evidence or a completed event-index review.
Research may continue, but the affected conclusion remains qualified.
A synthetic non-reliance event drives Gate 0, suppresses formal reports, and produces diagnostic-only rendering.

tests_executed.suite: Friday V1 frozen render, PDF, and pixel baseline
supplemental regression governance and AST anti-hardcoding

warnings: Live SEC filings and market observations are dated and may change after this acceptance run.
MISSING and WARNING pass acceptance only because the relevant conclusions and outputs remain constrained.
The three live cases do not claim to cover every future issuer or capital-structure pattern.
unresolved_issues: Active live fixtures are still needed for amended or restated filings, material subsequent events, negative FCF, negative EBITDA, high leverage, complex debt, and convertible or preferred securities.
These are future coverage extensions and do not negate the completed CROX, AZO, ODFL, safe-outcome, and anti-hardcoding acceptance defined for S08.

exact_next_starting_point.action: Before changing code, read the approved S09 definition from the development plan and freeze its exact scope. Do not infer S09 from adjacent Gate 4 or portfolio work.
